candidates.review_text:
This was my first visit to Ocean Prime. We went to this restaurant before seeing Miss Saigon. We had a reservation. When we arrived we were greeted and seated immediately. We were taken to the 2nd floor and seated. We ordered ordered off the Theatre Dinner. 
I ordered the Berry and Bubbles drink- it was delicious (I would ordered this drink again). For my  appetizer I ordered the white truffle caviar deviled eggs ( it was creamy and tasted so good), then my main course - sea scallops (both the scallops and risotto were cooked to perfection) and for dessert I had creme brulee (very nice sized dessert with caramelized sugar top with berries). I enjoyed my meal completely. The 3 other people in our group also enjoyed their meals. The restaurant was well lit with beautiful light fixtures. Our server was very professional and pleasant - her name was Naiomi. 
before leaving, I went to the bathroom. The bathroom was very clean and well maintained.  
I would return to this restaurant again. Positive experience all around.

Great food and drinks!
The restaurant itself was small and a tad dirty. Very loud!
The staff were eager to help one another which was great to see. 
The bathroom decor and architecture was amazing and I got some ideas for my future house!

My husband and I are riding this experience at 5 stars for several reasons. First when I called to request a reservation, I was politely greeting and not kept on hold long. Then when we arrived we didn't wait more than 2min to be seated and we were able to choose which table we wanted to sit at that our waitress was serving. I got the Spicy Shrimp Fra Diavolo and it was delicious! There was a perfect ratio of spicy tomato sauce to fresh homemade fettuccine , and the flavors were rival to the best Italian food I've ever had. There was plenty of shrimp in the dish, not skimpy like other places. My husband had a pizza and they were very accommodating to his specific request as he can be a picky eater especially when it comes to pizza. I was so happy they did not take offense to his order. He enjoyed it very much. I also want to note that the place was very clean, even the bathroom, which surprised me because there were plenty of people in the restaurant and I would have thought it may be neglected since I didn't see a lot of staff, but it was nice. I would definitely return here next time we visit PA.

The reviews of the fried chicken caught my eye, and the photos made everything look so appealing. When you find the place--it could almost lose a star for the location; it isn't in the hotel btw--you will be pleased by the scene and ambience alone. If you are looking for fast service and great food, you have won! This is the place. The turnaround time for the food is very impressive, as are the aromas. The tastes were superb! I had the fried chicken and my friend had the skirt steak. Both were cooked and seasoned perfectly. If you are a texture fiend, these are great options as well. The fried chicken comes with biscuits that are prepared to perfection and the zucchini pickles add the right amount of zing to the savory meal. We paired our meals with beers, which was a great choice. We couldn't decide on the awesomeness of the cocktails but the beer was perfect. 

We didn't have any dessert but the temptation was great. The desserts looked insanely delicious! 

The restaurant was very clean. I could appreciate the bathrooms not being a total mess, as is the case when trying to find a spot to eat during the weekend. No part of the service or the experience was lacking. 


This place is definitely worth the stop and revisit...several revisitations.
This place is adorable. It's what a coffee shop should be. Everyone has always been pleasant to me and I enjoyed the food and drink. However - the tables are filthy. That's my only complaint.
Great food but they could clean up a bit more. When we were there the tables were dirty and a bin of dirty dishes was laying by the door. Just clean up and you'll deserve 5 stars!

This is a cool looking restaurant. I love the decor and the food is good. I would recommend the cocktail with the lemon foam in it (I can't remember what they called it). The bathrooms were terrible. First of all they were very airplane like and second of all absolutely FILTHY. I felt like I needed a shower after using it.

Since the day this restaurant opened I have been meaning to dine here and I finally decided to! 
I took my boyfriend here for his birthday and we both left talking about how good the food was! 
It's a BYOB and no cork fee so that is a huge plus! We started with the cheese plate, shrimp and calamari. I am still drooling thinking about the calamari and cheese board!
The cheese board had really nice size portions of three cheeses and the paired spread were Delish! The calamari was really good too. The perfect crunch/chew consistency packed full of flavor with a little kick to it! Also the portions are the perfect shareable size and a great price as well. I had the duck breast entree and i was very happy that the dish came out well. Sometimes duck can be a bjt gamey. The desserts were tasteful as well! I highly recommend the fried Oreos! 

Additional comments:
- our server (the only one working) was so friendly and really gave his personal opinion for each dish he pointed out which I really liked! 
- the chef came out and asked us how we enjoyed our dinner which I LOVED! I feel like that doesn't happen anymore AND he brought us a shot of this concoction that he was making *how sweet*
- the bathroom was SO clean! When I opened the door I was surprised at how nice it smelled and how clean it looked. I also trust my gut and when a restaurant doesn't have a clean bathroom then who knows what the kitchen looks like; I typically won't eat at those places! 

I would return and dine here again! I think this can be the perfect place for a group of friends and all splits apps and a few bottles of wine!

The food is awesome and the service is swift and friendly. 
Pasta cooked to absolute perfection and the sauces were bright and beautiful. 
Honestly, there are two things that set this place above the others ... first, ambiance.  The setting is just gorgeous.  Everything you see looks like it's been there for ages, it's at home.  I felt like the space was serving its ultimate purpose in bringing people together.  Not a bunch of crap around to give the illusion of bringing people together. 
Second .... I believe this is the cleanest restaurant I've ever been in.  I am a bit of a nit picker ... the drapes were free of dust, the baseboards were clean, the glasses were spotless, the table ware was impeccably CLEAN. 
I kind of fell in love with this place.  I want to go back, I felt at home here. This place is a treasure.

We had a delicious breakfast here while staying downtown. Portions were hearty. Service was quick and friendly. Huge seating areas. 

The only area which seemed neglected was the bathroom which was dirty, had no paper towels, and TP was just sitting on handicap handrail instead of inside the dispenser (super gross!)

We went here with another couple after rave reviews from several friends.  First ...the food was superb.  We had various sushi rolls (one ordered special and not on the menu and it was no problem) plus pad Thai noodles and a rice dish.  Everything was superb. The service was also stellar. We made reservations online and although it was very crowded due to a function next door at U Penn...we were seated right away.  The only bad thing was the bathrooms.   Each is a separate room, like a 
Plane.  That's not the problem...the issue was they were all filthy.  We all used them and we all commented individually how disgusting they were.  Hair and dirty papers on the floor, mess everywhere.  They clearly had not been cleaned in quite awhile.  They truly were just rank and it left a bad impression on the restaurant.

My girlfriend and I went here during Restuarnt Week. The place was packed on arrival, however we were seated within minutes. Despite the small square footage I didn't feel cramped. It was loud but not overbearingly so. 

For restaurant week they use the same menu. You get a app, entree, and desert for the fixed price. 

For our meal we had:

Appetizer:
 Roasted Portabella Mushroom - great flavor and perfect texture
 Bruschetta - three large Bruschetta each with a unique topping. 

Entree:
  Shrimp & Lobster Pyramid - Three silver dollar sized "pyramids" with asparagus. beautiful presentation. delicate sauce. 
  my only complaint was that a lot of cheese flavors came through rather than shrimp/lobster.
 
  Veal Cutlet- delicious demi-glace. however, lots of olives made this dish a bit salty.

Desert:
 Cheesecake 
 Molten Chocolate Cake - no complaints in this department. 

Side note: bathroom was immaculate. Some of the restaurants on par with Mercato are guilty of the dirty baño, Capital Grille I'm looking at you.

All in all a wonderful experience and a great place to bring a date.

Came after being at a theater in the area. They opened at 5, and the waitress let us in a few minutes early. Since we were the first ones there, it was easy and quick to order, and the waiters had full attention on our water glasses. They don't just have thai food on the menu-- they have things for every palate, including meat options, veggies, fish and even escargot. I tried the escargot, which came with bread and a wonderfully flavorful pesto sauce, and the seared tuna salad, which was a mix up of many veggies, and came with mustard sauce and a soy salad sauce, not exactly sure what it was but it was good. The tuna was a small portion, but it went well with the mustard and the mixed salad, and the other sauce tied it all together! Definitely worth it.

My friend got the drunken noodles, which appeared to be a huge portion of chicken and noodles in a delicious sauce. He really enjoyed it as well. The restaurant was more upscale than I excepted, and we were really happy about the choice. Clean bathroom, friendly and quick staff, great experience!

Good food. Friendly staff. Fair prices. The Korean wings were excellent and the fries went great with them. The waitress was friendly and on point with everything. A friend and I sat outside for hours and she was always readily available to get us new drinks or to clear the table. She knew about the menu too which is always good because not all waitresses know what they're serving.   After 4 hours, food for 2 and several rounds of drinks the bill finally came and I was pleasantly surprised at how inexpensive it was. I would recommend this place to anyone. I haven't been inside at the bar so I'm not sure how the music or inside atmosphere is...but I do know when I went in to grab a menu real quick...I immediately noticed the place smelled wayyy better then the old tap room ever did. Glad there are new owners and that they're keeping it fresh in there. Whenever I went in there before it always smelled like dirty bar rags and the table tops were always sticky. Gross!

Came here for an afternoon dim sum fix. Left satisfied. The restaurant is very clean and the kitchen is open which is a statement on cleanliness and food safety. Dim sum was very tasty with easy to understand menu full of English and Chinese as well as color photos. Dishes were well done, not comparable to higher end places overseas but one of the best in the east coast. Staff was friendly and attentive. I do have a suggestion for management: replace the locking mechanisms on the bathroom doors so people know if it is occupied or not, similar to airline bathrooms. People were waiting in line for the one of two bathrooms and one was unoccupied the whole time.

Beautifully remodeled place. I love the contemporary look and feel. Lady who took my order was very nice too. The only thing that I would suggest is to clean it up a little bit. The bathroom was dirty and window next to me was in stains too. Even though I got here in the morning the place looked like it was not cleaned after late evening huge crowds passed by. But people who work here are very nice and this is the most important to me.
First of all, this place is very very clean!! Not smelly, not oily, the entire restaurant is spotless!! The food is unique, and homey :)  We ordered #1 and #8, both are very delicous!!

I went with a few girlfriends just because I wanted to try a rooftop bar and it was close to septa.  We walked in to a gorgeous building with hardwood floors, beautiful decorations, and an all-around cool vibe.  We went to the bar upstairs, and were served by the sweetest bartender of all time.  She was patient while we ordered, and very knowledgeable.  One of my friends who doesn't drink ordered a Shirley Temple, but the bartender asked if she wanted something fancier and enthusiastically went to make her a faujito (fake mojito) for free!  

We sat outside on their beeeeauuuutifullll deck that overlooks 2nd St, and decided to order a pizza 10 minutes before the kitchen closed ... yup .... we were those people.  Apparently the pizza guys had already gone home for the night, so our waiter made us the most delicious pizza ever by himself!  In most cases I would have expected a waiter to come back and tell us we ordered too late, but instead he just took extra time to make us what we wanted.  

Delicious food, great drinks, and exceptional service all around.  I'd definitely recommend for a night out. :)

Oh, and their bathrooms are really nice and clean -- definitely a sign of a good, clean restaurant in my eyes. :)
May be the dirtiest restaurant I've ever eaten in. Everything is sticky, stained and filthy. The bathrooms are even worse.

My experience here was okay. I mean the food was edible at least right? 

Ranging from overcooked noodles to old limp fried shrimp, they're presented on a shiny white platter that didn't seem to actually transfer any heat to the buffet selection. If the food temperature scale was 1-10 where 1 was cold, 5 was warm, and 10 was hot. I would say the food temp. was a 3.5. Not cold but not warm either. 

Aside from that, some of the food selection just felt old and poorly seasoned. Fish was salty, the soup was bland, noodles were way overcooked, fried shrimp not crisp, the chicken was dry, sushi was more rice/cream cheese/fake crab than fish, etc. 
There's also small selection. At first, the buffet looks big because there's a lot of rows but then you realize that each row has like 4-5 different entrees. 

Service was okay. Plates were taken, waters were refilled. However, some areas and plates felt dirty. But hey, at least the bathrooms were pretty clean. So kudos to them for doing something right.

Used to go here often when I lived nearby, stopped in recently and was surprised how neglected the place was, very dirty. Only 1 other table was being used but they were all filthy and this was shortly after opening, so the dining area was obviously not cleaned the night before, nor did they take the time to clean before they opened up.

Seems like both the night mgr and the day mgr don't care. I didn't get anything when I saw the state of the dining area.

If they're filthy when they open up imagine what else is being neglected that we can't see.

This place is waaaay dirty. From the stench in the dining room to the dumpster goo that oozes out onto the sidewalk on 11th Street, everything about this place skeeves me out. The food isn't bad, but the lack of cleanliness is horrific.

We have been going here for years. The food and staff are excellent, but the rest tooms are disgustingly filthy. And today I looked at the flooring in the main space and saw its as bad ad the bathrooms. So I felt its time to write this.
Its a shame there is this contrast between the food presentation and lack of cleanliness. I have thought about this every time we are there and now find I will not return until that changes.
Generally, Philadelphia seems loose with regulating city cleanliness, so maybe thats why this restaurant shows this.
Regardless, I cant help thinking the germs from the filth gets on the food at some point, which has turned me away.

This is a nice place to have breakfast  or lunch. There is decent food, but the cleanliness of the kitchen staff is horrible. I came in and sat in the bar and immediately notice that the people in the kitchen do NOT were gloves. They touched everything, the broom stick, the kitchen floor, their underarm.  They go out to break come back and not  even wash there hands.. Etc. etc.. Therefore, I will not be eating in this place again.  Where Gloves it's very unsanitary...

This place is so dirty! There was hair practically on all my utensils. Before my food could come to the table I had to cancel my order because the owner (who I thought was a customer at the time) waltzed in dramatically sneezing and coughing everywhere. This proceeded all the way up until he entered the KITCHEN. When he came out of the KITCHEN he was then seen blowing his nose & walking around the restaurant without ever washing his hands! After that he started clearing off tables -_-

DO NOT EAT!!!! This used to be our go to spot. It's was Filthy as the street. DISGUSTING! The ladies room was so filthy, my mother had to clean it with paper towel and the 1 pump of soap so that my little girls could use it. The sink has been clogged for ten years! The filth on the floor, black grease and slippery surfaces all over the floor. The exhaust over the grill smelled like sewage. The window sill where the silver vents are were filled with black grease and dirt. I am calling the health department and L&I. If the outter appearance is that gross, IMAGINE THE KITCHEN. I asked for soy sauce, got some will old sauce on it. And the cook was inexperienced and server was Arrogant.
Dirty and smelly--unappetizing chain restaurant that makes me want to carry my own industrial strength bleach in my purse. Absolutely disgusting sanitation!
The food is excellent, but the place is dirty. The bathrooms, both men's and women's, were so filthy the last time we tried to go here that we cancelled our order and walked out.

Was there this past Saturday, drive thru was backed up so we went in. The place was very dirty, straws, food and napkins all throughout the lobby, food all over floor behind counter. We left. If it's that visibly dirty, basic food hygiene is probably being ignored as well.

First, I must say that the pizza and salads are some of the best that I've had, but for me, it's best experienced as take-out.  Dear Owners, please CLEAN your restaurant.  The dirt on the walls is visible. No white glove needed. You can scratch your name into the grime.  Even the doors of the bathroom and light switches are visible dirty.   If we had NYC sanitation ratings, this place would be an F!  I want this to be a go-to-place for casual night outs, but...

My boyfriend and I came here the other day. There were maybe three tables with people. The hostess literally sat us the dirtiest table (it had food visibly on it) and she didn't mention anything. So we sat ourselves, assuming she's blind. Food was decent, overpriced for the value and taste. After we left, we went to a bar and walked past Max Brenner after it closed. This is what we saw, chairs on top of the tables with the dirty legs on the table!! I understand you have to mop, but have never seen this. It's disgusting. Basically, your table has floor germs on it. If you mop, move chairs, but don't put them on the table. Won't be coming back here.

The place seem nice, but the floors were dirty (the waiter said they sweep after every shift but it doesn't seem so) it need a good sweep and mop down. Fruit flies was hovering over our table and the dishes they serve our food wasn't properly clean but the staff was nice. They offer a different table once we point out the nats ( they were overbearing)

This place was so dirty, if I could give 0 stars I would.  This was by far the worst restaurant I have taken my family to in a long, long while.  The prices were inflated, they messed up the order (3 items missing). I will not plan to eat here again.  Philadelphia health inspectors need to pay a visit.  There is a leaking ceiling on the second floor, the tables, seats and floors are filthy!  The doors are visibly covered in ketchup and other food stains, there was a dirty broom laying on the condiment area with the platic cutlery.  Yuck, yuck, yuck!  The owners of this place need to be ashamed as this is supposed to be a reputable publicly traded company.  Shareholders beware..

Ok- we sat down to eat in this restaurant and had to get up to leave. I have never seen such a dirty floor in my life. It really creeped me out and I could not make myself give them the benefit of the doubt and order. I feel bad for leaving such a poor review but "Eek! Methinks not" describes my thoughts exactly when looking around this restaurant.

The smell that smacks you in the face when you walk in the front door is absolutely disgusting! How on earth does management let this continue?? Everything you touch, from the menus to the bar counter itself is sticky... The furniture is completely soiled that it looks like someone sat in their own oily, filthy self for a decade. If that's how the front of the house is, I don't even want to think about the kitchen... Stay away!!!

Food was good but I could not look past this places sanitary practices. We sat in the front next to the sink. This one guy would pile dirty cups and empty drinks onto/into the pile of used cups all night. He would clean tables with some nasty rag that was never put in a solution and then throw on top of the giant pile of dirty cups. He would use that rag to "clean" tables..over and over... He would occasionally ring it out over a bucket that they throw all their bowls and chopsticks into. The waitresses, hostess and this guy would rush around so much that during our hour here they dropped used bowls, cups, chopsticks or whatever else was in their hands on the floor over 5 times. Bowls would go flying under our table. They would come scramble.. pick all the dirty stuff off the floor with their hands, throw it in a bucket, and then continue to go about their shift. Set a table.. dig threw a bucket of "clean" chopsticks (not wrapped) with their dirty hands and bring them to your table. The guy "cleaned" those cups later at the end of our dinner with a sponge. His method? Quick wipe around top where you put your lips and rinse. Places sanitary practices and overall environment are severely lacking. It's overly stimulating.. loud and dirty. I'm surprised it's so packed. I'd like to think they were severely understaffed last night. I know restaurants aren't the cleanest of places but when they do things like this right in front of your face it is kind of scary to think what they do behind closed doors.

请从输入评论中恰好选择4条：2条明确满足要求，expected_direction=positive；2条明确违反要求，expected_direction=negative。每条评论最多使用一次。

1. query_text 必须是自然的中文找餐馆问题，只表达当前固定特征和指定方向。

3. requirement_text 用简短中文写清需要评论回答的要求。

      "expected_direction": "positive或negative",
      "evidence_span": "从对应review_text逐字复制的连续原文"
    }
  ]
}

drafts必须恰好有4项，且必须是2项positive和2项negative。
